name: agent-toolkit
description: Claude Code plugins for shipping code safely: PR description, review and risk scoring, platform skills, and guardrail hooks.

plugins.name: pr-workflow
plugins.description: Describe, review and risk-score pull requests. Includes a free, rule-based PR risk scorer that also runs as a GitHub Action.

plugins.name: platform
plugins.description: Platform engineering skills: Terraform latency/error monitors with Slack alerts, and deterministic seed data for multi-state QA scenarios.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Hooks that block secrets before they are written or committed, and lint files right after Claude edits them.

plugins.name: i-have-adhd
plugins.description: Upstream plugin by Ayoub G. (MIT): action-first, ADHD-friendly output. pr-describe and pr-review follow its shape when it is on.
